fields.description: Parkside Hills offers one to three bedroom apartments in Dubai Hills Estate, close to the park and mall. The design uses a landscaped podium for shared leisure, with pools, fitness areas and places to gather. Apartment options vary by floor and position, from compact one-bedroom homes to three-bedroom layouts with a maid’s room.

overview: The brochure describes a residents’ lounge leading to an elevated podium, with indoor and outdoor exercise spaces, adult and children’s pools, and a barbecue area. Interiors use earthy tones and a contemporary finish palette. Depending on position, homes are marketed towards the park, landscaped podium, mall or Address Hillcrest community; a particular view should be checked against the unit’s orientation and surrounding development.
research.locationNote: Parkside Hills is in Dubai Hills Estate, with access to Al Khail Road and the wider road network. Dubai Hills Park, the mall and golf club are nearby district destinations. References to Etihad Rail and Dubai Metro are future-planning statements rather than confirmation of an operating local station.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises AED 1.51m. The February 2024 fact sheet lists launch starts of AED 1.51m, AED 2.19m and AED 3.73m for one, two and three bedrooms. These historical category prices do not establish current stock or an individual resale quotation.
research.paymentNote: The published launch schedule totals 90% before completion and 10% on completion. It includes a 15% stage followed by a 5% stage; it is not ten equal instalments. Request current outstanding payments for the unit.
research.handoverNote: June 2028 is the completion estimate in the payment document and Property Finder. Confirm the current contractual programme and construction position.

facts.label: Published apartment mix
facts.value: The fact sheet lists 141 one-bedroom, 177 two-bedroom and 52 three-bedroom homes: 370 apartments in total. These are development totals, not availability.

facts.label: Corner outdoor space
facts.value: Ground-floor two-bedroom corner unit G01 totals 1,317.18 sq ft, including 371.03 sq ft of balcony. The comparable level-one unit 114 totals 1,311.80 sq ft. Compare outdoor area separately from the 946.15 sq ft suite.

facts.label: Three-bedroom arrangement
facts.value: Type A includes a maid’s room with bathroom, laundry, storage and a powder room. Published three-bedroom plans start on upper residential levels; confirm the specific floor and outlook.

facts.label: Current status needs checking
facts.value: Property Finder shows a sold-out developer label with resale listings. Its progress update is dated January 2026, so it is not treated here as a current construction inspection.
